question.text: The disperse phase in colloidal iron (III) hydroxide and colloidal gold is positively and negatively charged, respectively. Which of the following statements is NOT correct?

options.text: Magnesium chloride solution coagulates, the gold solution more readily than the iron (III) hydroxide solution
Sodium sulphate solution causes coagulation in both the solutions
Mixing of the solutions has no effect
Coagulation in both solutions can be brought about by electrophoresis

solution.text: Opposite charges attract each other. Hence on mixing, coagulation of two solutions may take place.
